description: 精致治愈系现代日漫电影静止帧，强调二维美型人物、电影式构图、通透背景和冷暖分区光。

style_analysis.linework: Clean 2D anime hand-drawn line art. Clear, continuous, slightly weighted dark ink contours define the outer silhouette and structural edges; facial features and clothing folds remain precise and legible, with no painterly edges or 3D contour rendering.
style_analysis.character_rendering: Refined modern seinen anime character design. Adult characters have natural balanced proportions but simplified 2D anime facial geometry: clean eye shapes, minimal nose and mouth marks, flat skin color, and restrained hard-edged shadows. Avoid deep facial creases, heavy eye sockets, pronounced philtrum lines, pores, and photographic facial structure.
style_analysis.coloring: Pure Japanese anime cel shading. Large clean flat color areas with clear two- to three-level hard-edged shadows; no overly smooth gradients, painterly brushwork, or volumetric 3D lighting.
style_analysis.background: Detailed Japanese hand-painted anime background art. Modern Japanese home entryways and streets use accurate perspective and clear depth separation, with a delicate watercolor or painted background texture that contrasts with the flat 2D characters.
style_analysis.palette_lighting: Transparent modern Japanese anime film lighting. Low-saturation blue-gray and deep green establish the environment, with warm amber practical light creating clear cool-warm separation. Use crisp but restrained rim light and clean highlights; add window, rain, wet-ground reflections, or subtle glow only when supported by the scene.
style_analysis.composition: Cinematic Japanese animation medium-shot language. Give the character expression and the surrounding space equal narrative purpose, with clear silhouettes, separated depth layers, and quiet controlled negative space.
style_analysis.exclusions: 3D render, CGI, live-action photo, painterly rendering, game-engine render, Octane Render, realistic skin texture, skin pores, plastic highlights, unlined characters, western comic style, live-action webtoon style, oversaturated colors, speech bubbles, readable text, watermark.

compiled_prompt: High-quality modern Japanese 2D hand-drawn anime film still. Pure cel animation texture with clear 2D ink linework, flat color blocks, and two- to three-level hard-edged shadows. Refined anime facial features and clean flat skin color remain consistent even in serious scenes. Use transparent low-saturation blue-gray and deep green environmental tones, warm amber practical light, restrained rim highlights, and clear cool-warm separation for a quiet cinematic narrative atmosphere.
negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, live-action photo, painterly rendering, game-engine render, Octane Render, realistic skin texture, skin pores, plastic highlights, unlined characters, western comic style, live-action webtoon style, oversaturated colors, speech bubbles, readable text, watermark.
